name: PDF Tables → Excel
description: Drop a text-based PDF and get an Excel workbook of its tables — one sheet per page — entirely on your device. Built for SERFF insurance rate/rule filings, which are born-digital, so the numbers are read exactly (no OCR, no guessing) and nothing is ever sent anywhere. Reads the PDF with pdf.js, reconstructs the row/column grid from the text positions, and writes a real .xlsx with SheetJS. A scanned (image-only) PDF is reported honestly rather than exported empty.
